scientific_integrity: Original quartic pencil, geometry, and classical Artin–Schreier/cubic-resolvent methods attributed to prior work. The new result is the exact four-secant/elliptic-resolvent arithmetic relationship. Finite computational tests are corroboration, not proofs.
scientific_limitations: Counts distinct smooth finite-field points on projective lines; excludes \(t=0\) and member at parameter infinity. Auxiliary elliptic curve exists for \(t^3\ne1\), degenerate case separately proved. Not a classification of full scheme-theoretic line sections. Independent audit not performed.
title: Elliptic resolvents for four-secants of the Hilario–Stöhr quartic pencil
